name: @awebai/claude-skills
description: Content-only aweb skills for Claude Code and Pi: coordination, optional task tracking, messaging, membership, bootstrap, and identity.

scripts.sync-skills: rm -rf skills && mkdir -p skills && cp -R ../../skills/aweb-coordination ../../skills/aweb-tasks ../../skills/aweb-messaging ../../skills/aweb-team-membership ../../skills/aweb-bootstrap ../../skills/aweb-identity skills/
scripts.prepack: npm run sync-skills && npm run sync-plugin-version
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run sync-skills && npm run sync-plugin-version
